# Introduction

# DATA Wrangling


```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(tidymodels)

# Import original data
listings <- read.csv("https://ajohns24.github.io/data/NYC_airbnb_kaggle.csv")
nbhd     <- read.csv("https://ajohns24.github.io/data/NYC_nbhd_kaggle.csv")

# Wrangle this into the final airbnb data
set.seed(253)
airbnb <- listings %>% 
  filter(price > 0, price < 1000) %>% 
  sample_n(size = 5000) %>% 
  rename(neighbourhood = neighbourhood_cleansed) %>% 
  left_join(nbhd) %>% 
  select(-neighbourhood, -amenities, -host_response_rate, -calendar_updated)
```


```{r}
# Create wrangling recipe
airbnb_recipe <- recipe(price ~ ., data = airbnb) %>% 
  step_rm(
    latitude, longitude, host_response_time, host_is_superhost, 
    host_has_profile_pic, is_location_exact, review_scores_rating, 
    cancellation_policy, require_guest_profile_picture, reviews_per_month
  ) %>% 
  step_string2factor(all_nominal_predictors()) %>%
  step_impute_knn(all_predictors(), neighbors = 5) 
```


```{r}
# Train the recipe on the data and view head
airbnb_baked <- airbnb_recipe %>% 
  prep() %>% 
  bake(new_data = NULL)

head(airbnb_baked)
```

**Plots**

```{r}
# Plot 1: Predictors used (2): accommodation capacity, roomtype
ggplot(airbnb_baked, aes(x = accommodates, y = price, color = room_type)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.4, position = "jitter") +
  geom_smooth(method = "loess", se = FALSE, size = 1.2) +
  labs(
    title = "Price Trends by Physical Capacity and Room Type",
    x = "Number of Guests Accommodated",
    y = "Nightly Price ($)",
    color = "Room Type"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
# Plot 2: Price Distributions Across Neighborhood Groups (Boroughs)
ggplot(airbnb_baked, aes(x = neighbourhood_group, y = price, fill = neighbourhood_group)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.7, outlier.alpha = 0.2) +
  labs(
    title = "AirBnB Price Distributions Across NYC Boroughs",
    x = "Borough",
    y = "Nightly Price ($)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```

```{r}
# Plot 3: Interactions Between Capacity, Location, and Price Predictors used (2): accommodation capacity, neighborhood location
ggplot(airbnb_baked, aes(x = accommodates, y = price)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.3, size = 1) +
  geom_smooth(method = "loess", color = "blue", se = FALSE) +
  facet_wrap(~ neighbourhood_group) +
  labs(
    title = "Price Scaling by Capacity Faceted by Borough",
    x = "Number of Guests Accommodated",

  theme_light()
```
```{r}
# Plot 4: Predictors used (3): property_type, bedrooms, beds
ggplot(airbnb_baked, aes(x = bedrooms, y = price, color = property_type)) +
  geom_point(aes(size = beds), alpha = 0.5, position = position_jitter(width = 0.15, height = 0)) +

```


> LASSO Model

```{r}
airbnb_reduced <- airbnb %>%
  select(-id, -square_feet) %>%
  mutate(reviews_per_month = replace_na(reviews_per_month, 0)) 
```


```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(tidymodels)

# Define model specification
airbnb_lasso_spec <- linear_reg() |> 
  set_mode("regression") |> 
  set_engine("glmnet") |> 
  set_args(mixture = 1, penalty = tune())

# Define recipe preprocessing steps
airbnb_variable_recipe <- recipe(price ~ ., data = airbnb) |> 
  step_rm(id) |> 
  step_string2factor(all_nominal_predictors()) |> 
  step_impute_knn(all_predictors(), neighbors = 5) |> 
  step_dummy(all_nominal_predictors()) 
 
```

```{r}
# Bundle into workflow
airbnb_lasso_workflow <- workflow() |> 
  add_recipe(airbnb_variable_recipe) |> 
  add_model(airbnb_lasso_spec)
```


```{r}
# Tune model over cross-validation grid
set.seed(253)
airbnb_lasso_models <- airbnb_lasso_workflow |> 
  tune_grid(
    grid = grid_regular(penalty(range = c(-3, 1)), levels = 50),
    resamples = vfold_cv(airbnb, v = 10),
    metrics = metric_set(mae)
  )
```


```{r}
# Plot cross-validation results
autoplot(airbnb_lasso_models) + 
  scale_x_continuous() + 
  xlab(expression(lambda))
```

```{r}
# Select optimal penalty parameter
best_penalty <- airbnb_lasso_models |> 
  select_best(metric = "mae")

best_penalty

parsimonious_penalty <- airbnb_lasso_models |> 
  select_by_one_std_err(metric = "mae", desc(penalty))

parsimonious_penalty
```


```{r}
# Finalize workflow and fit full model
airbnb_final_lasso <- airbnb_lasso_workflow |> 
  finalize_workflow(parameters = parsimonious_penalty) |> 
  fit(data = airbnb)

# View non-zero coefficient estimates
airbnb_final_lasso |> 
  tidy() |> 
  filter(estimate != 0) %>% 
  arrange(desc(abs(estimate)))
```

- Looking at this model, there's is longitude but there's no latitude within the model which also doesn't make a lot of sense because longitude is a coordinate and has to go with another latitude coordinate. Which means if we remove it from the dataset we need to also remove the latitude column too.
